name: agent-harness-vscode
description: A Claude-powered coding agent with its own tool loop, in a VS Code side panel.

agentHarness.model.description: Claude model ID used by the agent.

agentHarness.effort.description: How much effort (thinking depth and token spend) the model puts into each turn.

agentHarness.maxTokens.description: Maximum output tokens per model response.

agentHarness.autoApproveReads.description: Run read-only tools (read, list, search) without asking.

agentHarness.commandTimeoutSec.description: Kill terminal commands that run longer than this many seconds.

agentHarness.refusalFallback.description: If the model declines a request, let the API retry it on a fallback model automatically.

agentHarness.teammateModel.description: Model for new teammates. Empty means the same as the lead (agentHarness.model).

agentHarness.maxTeammates.description: Maximum number of teammates (not counting the lead).

agentHarness.maxAutoTurns.description: Maximum automatic (message-triggered) agent turns per team before agents pause; refilled whenever you send a message.

agentHarness.maxTurnIterations.description: Maximum model calls in a single agent turn before the turn ends with a notice.

agentHarness.maxTeamOutputTokens.description: Team-wide budget in output-equivalent tokens (output tokens plus input and cache tokens, weighted by price). When it is used up, all agents pause. It refills when you send a message.

scripts.build: npm run build:ext && npm run build:webview
